query: What patient needs appear in visit notes?

per_column.name: visit_purpose_category
per_column.rationale: Provides a clean categorical axis (acute vs chronic vs preventive vs emergency) directly relevant to 'what patient needs appear.' Samples map soundly: annual physical->preventive_wellness, cough->acute_complaint, post-MI->chronic_disease_management. Well grounded.

per_column.name: clinical_problem_type
per_column.rationale: Body-system categorization gives a strong grouping axis for patient needs. Mostly sound (URI->infectious, acne->dermatologic, knee->musculoskeletal). The annual-physical row labeled endocrine_metabolic is a slight stretch (fatigue + HbA1c warrant it, but weakly), and NULLs are handled appropriately. Generally grounded.

per_column.name: acuity_complexity_level
per_column.rationale: A 1-5 severity scale offers a useful ordinal axis distinct from the existing urgency column. Values are plausible inferences but somewhat subjective and only loosely warranted by text (e.g. 2 vs 3 assignments not sharply justified). Reasonable but softer grounding.

per_column.name: care_continuity_stage
per_column.rationale: New vs ongoing vs surveillance is a genuine analytical axis for needs, and it is well grounded: 'Follow-up after MI'->ongoing_followup, injury 'yesterday'->new_problem, annual exam->surveillance_monitoring are sound readings.

per_column.name: intervention_need_type
per_column.rationale: Captures what care was delivered/needed, a core dimension of the query. Mostly sound (adapalene/doxycycline->medication_initiated; supportive care->conservative_management). However knee visit labeled 'procedure_performed' when text only shows MRI ordered, no procedure done—an over-assertion. Otherwise reasonable.

per_column.name: specialist_referral_need
per_column.rationale: Referral need is relevant to patient needs. Silent rows correctly 'not_present.' But the knee row labeled 'orthopedics' referral is questionable since the visit is already in Orthopedics and no referral is stated—a possible unwarranted inference. Mostly grounded otherwise.

per_column.name: diagnostic_workup_need
per_column.rationale: Imaging/lab/multimodal categorization is directly extractable and useful. Samples align well (lipid+HbA1c->multiple_modalities, MRI->imaging_ordered, repeat lipid->lab_ordered, viral URI->not_present). Well grounded.

per_column.name: preventive_or_screening_need
per_column.rationale: Preventive/screening axis is relevant and mostly grounded; silent acute rows correctly 'not_present.' Labeling the annual-exam lipid/HbA1c as metabolic_screening is a sound reading. Some overlap with visit_purpose_category (preventive_wellness) but adds finer granularity.

judge.rationale: The added columns collectively provide multiple distinct, non-redundant axes (purpose, body system, acuity, continuity, intervention, referral, workup, prevention) that all genuinely serve the query about patient needs in visit notes. None are trivial constants or bare token-count/sentiment features. Grounding is generally strong: extractions and categorizations track the source text, and silent rows are handled with 'not_present'/NULL appropriately. Minor over-assertions exist (knee 'procedure_performed' and 'orthopedics' referral where text supports neither, and some subjective acuity assignments), keeping groundedness just short of top marks, but no systematic hallucination.
